veranderings.voor: lig of klank of beweging of hitte
veranderings.rede: The repeated 'of' is wooden; a list with commas and one final 'of' reads naturally.

veranderings.voor: Drade maak die pad volledig en 'n skakelaar
veranderings.na: Drade maak die pad volledig, en 'n skakelaar
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Ses stelsels wat elke dag probleme oplos
veranderings.voor: mense kan in die nag sien
veranderings.rede: 'snags' is the natural Afrikaans adverb; 'in die nag' is stiff here.

veranderings.blok: Ses stelsels wat elke dag probleme oplos
veranderings.voor: sê vir bestuurders wanneer om te ry en te stop
veranderings.na: sê vir bestuurders wanneer hulle moet ry en wanneer hulle moet stop
veranderings.rede: 'wanneer om te ry' copies English 'when to drive'; Afrikaans needs a clause with subject and modal verb.

veranderings.voor: modelle en speelgoed en daar is
veranderings.na: modelle en speelgoed, en daar is
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: the second 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
'lighuis' follows English 'lighthouse'; the standard Afrikaans word is 'vuurtoring', which also fits 'bo-in die toring' in the same block.

veranderings.voor: breek hy die pad en so hou
veranderings.na: breek hy die pad, en so hou
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
The fixed Afrikaans expression is 'met die hand'.

veranderings.voor: maak hulle stroombaan toe deur die ding wat gebeur
veranderings.na: maak hulle stroombaan heel deur iets wat gebeur
veranderings.rede: 'die ding wat gebeur' is vague and wooden, and 'toe' is the open/closed wording the lesson's decided skakelaar definition avoids in favour of 'heel'.
'dieselfde' makes clear that the loop and the wire share one circuit; 'een' can read as 'a circuit'.

veranderings.voor: dan is die pad volledig en die sirene lui
veranderings.na: dan is die pad volledig, en die sirene lui
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
The prop is the plug; what a heater is plugged into is the 'muursok', and one plugs 'in' a socket.

veranderings.voor: Mense moet die sirene kan hoor en die lig
veranderings.na: Mense moet die sirene kan hoor, en die lig
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

vlae.rede: 'dit' could refer to the path (die pad), the device or the whole system; naming the referent would mean guessing the intended content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
The game is named as if the learner knows it; the compound could also be written closed ('vastehandspel'). The hyphen is allowed for clarity, so this was left unchanged.
